criteria.requirement: Use a trusted Functions subclass with @signature and _func_store_key plus explicit Options(custom_functions=instance). Calls with those options produce warehouse-a and reject numeric input, while ordinary calls raise UnknownFunctionError and built-ins still work. Do not monkeypatch global registration or execute untrusted Python; bound expression/data work separately.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
